problem.complexity: O(n) expected time and O(n) space.
problem.explanation: A hash map records the earliest index for each previously seen value.
hints: Look for `target - value` before storing the current index.
problem.statement_markdown: Implement `find_pair(values, target)`. Return the indices of the first pair encountered while scanning left-to-right whose values sum to target, or an empty list.
problem.title: Find a target pair
